description: A chaotic oscillator that steps the Rössler attractor forward one sample at a time and puts its three coordinates out as three voltages, deterministic but never repeating

params.text: Sets how far the system is stepped forward on each sample, which works like a pitch control; fully counter-clockwise the system stops moving and the outputs go quiet
Sets the constant A of the equations, from 0.05 to 0.33, and its effect on the sound is not predictable
Sets the constant B of the equations, from 0.9 fully counter-clockwise down to 0.15 fully clockwise, and its effect on the sound is not predictable
Sets the constant C of the equations, from 5.5 to 16.5, and its effect on the sound is not predictable
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the RATE input before it is added to the RATE knob, and at dead centre that input is ignored
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the A input before it is added to the A knob, and at dead centre that input is ignored
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the B input before it is added to the B knob, and at dead centre that input is ignored
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the C input before it is added to the C knob, and at dead centre that input is ignored
Switches between two speed ranges: unlit the system is stepped seven times a sample and RATE reaches 600 steps a second, lit it is stepped once and RATE reaches 80

inputs.text: Shifts the step size away from the RATE knob, through the attenuverter above it; the total is held between stopped and the top of whichever range the HF/LF button is in
Shifts the A constant away from its knob, through the attenuverter above it; the total is held between 0.05 and 0.33
Shifts the B constant away from its knob, through the attenuverter above it; the total is held between 0.15 and 0.9
Shifts the C constant away from its knob, through the attenuverter above it; the total is held between 5.5 and 16.5
Puts the system back to its starting point on each rising edge past 2V, falling ready again below 0.1V; because the system is deterministic that makes it a sync input

outputs.text: The first coordinate of the system, direct voltage removed, reaching a few volts either way
The second coordinate of the system, direct voltage removed, reaching a few volts either way and covering a different part of the spectrum from the first
The third coordinate of the system, direct voltage removed and scaled down further because it swings much wider than the other two

notes: with RATE fully counter-clockwise nothing moves and all three outputs stay at 0V; turn RATE up for any sound at all
each of the four CV inputs is read through the attenuverter above it, and every attenuverter starts at dead centre, so a cable alone changes nothing until that small knob is turned
if the system runs away and any coordinate passes its limit, the module puts itself back to its starting point without being asked, which is heard as a click

inputs.4:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
